details:
Q1: What specifically should be improved?
Choices:
A. Name the workflow, script, prompt, documentation page, or behavior and describe the current problem. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Provide a failing run, error message, or reproducible scenario.
C. Describe the affected pipeline phase and user-facing pain point.
Q2: What observable outcome should define success?
Choices:
A. Provide concrete acceptance criteria or expected behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Provide an example of the desired before-and-after behavior.
C. Identify the metric to improve and its target value.
